title: 第13章 神异小鼎第14章 灵液
lines: 翌日，
王扶按照冯大富分配的任务，开始清除药田的杂草，十方药田里的杂草已经长得很深了，王扶费了一上午，才清除三方药田的杂草，杂草堆在屋子外，足有半人高。
“看来这两天得辛苦一下了。”
吃过午饭，王扶继续清除杂草，一直到傍晚时分。
几个不速之客忽然到来。
“你就是新来的那个小子？”
一共四人，另外三个很明显以中间一人为首。
看著来者不善的四人，王扶只能小心应对。
“我叫王扶，几位师兄有什么事么？”
为首的少年一只脚踩著凳子，倨傲的看著王扶:“来找你自然有事，这百草谷是我朱震的地盘，你既然来了这里就得听我吩咐。”
王扶本能的眉头一皱，但他还是笑呵呵的拱手道:“没想到是朱师兄，久仰久仰，朱师兄有什么吩咐儘管说。”
“嗯，看你挺识时务，比你隔壁的黑小子听话。
我也不为难你，从明天开始，每天去百草谷的清灵潭挑二十桶水到百草谷上面的灵池里。”
朱震沉声说道，旁边的三个少年一脸幸灾乐祸，百草谷挑水的活，以前都是他们负责，只不过自从和朱震打好关係之后，原本每日挑水的活都被分给了其他人。
尤其是还没引灵气入体的新人。
“朱师兄，这……不太合適吧，冯主事给我的任务可不是这个……”
王扶当然不想把时间浪费在挑水上面，他还要修炼，只有搬出冯大富试试。
然而，朱震旁边的少年却猛然一脚踹过来。
“去你妈的……给你脸了！”
嘭！
王扶根本来不及反应，只觉得一股斐然巨力仿佛铁锤砸在肚子上，整个人直接飞出丈许，重重的摔在屋子前的草堆上。
肠子似乎都被这一脚踢断了，强烈的疼痛让他蜷缩成一团，浑身颤抖，冷汗直冒，上气不接下气。
似乎下一刻就会死掉。
“朱师兄吩咐的事你还敢顶嘴，都他么是一些贱骨头，不给你点顏色看看，还以为我们是来找你商量不成？”
那少年恶狠狠的瞪著草堆上的蜷缩一团的王扶。
朱震在一旁神色冷淡，没有丝毫怜悯之心，他居高临下，俯视著王扶，仿佛在看一个螻蚁:“记住了，二十桶清灵潭的潭水，我会找人监督验收，若是未完成，呵呵……就不是张恆这一脚这么简单了。”
王扶蜷缩著，一言不发，杂乱的头髮下，一双眼睛直直的盯著四人，尤其是朱震和行凶的张……恆，將他们的面貌一点一点的刻在脑子里。
“你放心，这里不允许杀人，但废你手脚还是没问题，希望你不要不知好歹。”
朱震冷笑，“至於冯主事……他可不会管这些閒事。”
记恨？呵呵，这么多人都记恨他，可那又如何？
朱震带著张恆三人走了，只留下王扶仍旧蜷缩在草堆上，痉挛著，抽搐著。
不远处，黑瘦少年黄錚在自己屋子里，透过缝隙看著这一幕，他摸了摸胸口的伤疤，隨著嘴角上扬，一声声偷笑充斥了整个漆黑的屋子。
是夜，王扶在草堆上沉沉睡去。
星空之下，他胸口的小鼎自己显现了实体，草堆上一缕一缕微不可查的光芒仿佛飘荡的尘沙，钻入小鼎之中。
苍翠的草堆渐渐失去了本来的顏色，变成了枯黄的杂草。
清晨，王扶被刺眼的阳光弄醒。
content_en:
The next day,
In accordance with the tasks assigned by Feng Dafu, Wang Fu began to clear the weeds in the medicinal field. The weeds in the Shifang medicinal field had grown very deep. Wang Fu spent a whole morning clearing the weeds in the Sanfang medicinal field. The weeds were piled outside the house, as high as half a person.
"Looks like I have to work hard these two days."
After lunch, Wang Fu continued to clear weeds until evening.
Several uninvited guests suddenly arrived.
"Are you the new kid?"
There were four people in total, and the other three were obviously headed by the middle one.
Seeing the four people who came with bad intentions, Wang Fu could only deal with them carefully.
"My name is Wang Fu, what can I do to you senior fellow apprentices?"
The leading boy stepped on the stool with one foot and looked at Wang Fu arrogantly: "Of course I have something to do when I come to you. This Baicao Valley is my Zhu Zhen's territory. Since you are here, you must obey my orders."
Wang Fu frowned instinctively, but he still smiled and said, "I didn't expect it to be Senior Brother Zhu. I have admired him for a long time. If you have any orders from Senior Brother Zhu, just tell me."
"Well, I see you are quite aware of current affairs and more obedient than the black guy next door to you.
I won’t make it difficult for you. Starting from tomorrow, you will go to Qingling Pond in Baicao Valley to pick up twenty buckets of water to the Lingchi above Baicao Valley every day. "
Zhu Zhen said in a deep voice, and the three teenagers next to him looked gloating. They used to be responsible for carrying water in Baicao Valley, but since they established a good relationship with Zhu Zhen, the daily water carrying work has been assigned to others.
Especially newcomers who haven't introduced spiritual energy into their bodies yet.
"Senior Brother Zhu, this...isn't appropriate. The task that Chief Feng gave me is not this..."
Of course Wang Fu didn't want to waste time fetching water. He still wanted to practice, so he could only try to move out of Feng Dafu.
However, the boy next to Zhu Zhen suddenly kicked him over.
"Fuck you... I'll give you face!"
Bang!
Wang Fu had no time to react. He only felt a huge force like a hammer hitting his stomach. He flew directly out of the sky and fell heavily on the haystack in front of the house.
His intestines seemed to have been broken by this kick. The intense pain made him curl up into a ball, trembling all over, breaking out in cold sweat, and out of breath.
It seems that he will die in the next moment.
"You still dare to talk back to Senior Brother Zhu when he asked you to do something? Are you a bitch? If you don't give you some clues, you think we are here to discuss it with you?"
The young man glared fiercely at Wang Fu, who was huddled on the haystack.
Zhu Zhen looked cold and showed no mercy. He looked down at Wang Fu from a high position, as if looking at an ant: "Remember, I will find someone to supervise and accept the twenty barrels of Qinglingtan water. If it is not completed, haha... it is not as simple as Zhang Heng's kick."
Wang Fu curled up and said nothing. Under his messy hair, a pair of eyes stared directly at the four people, especially Zhu Zhen and the perpetrator Zhang... Heng, etching their faces in his mind bit by bit.
"Don't worry, killing is not allowed here, but it's okay to cripple your hands and feet. I hope you won't be ungrateful."
Zhu Zhen sneered, "As for Chief Feng...he won't meddle in such nosy matters."
Hold a grudge? Haha, so many people hate him, but so what?
Zhu Zhen took Zhang Heng and the others away, leaving only Wang Fu still huddled on the haystack, convulsing and twitching.
Not far away, Huang Zheng, a thin and dark boy, was in his room, watching the scene through the gap. He touched the scar on his chest, and as the corners of his mouth rose, snickers filled the dark room.
…
That night, Wang fell asleep on the haystack.
Under the starry sky, the small cauldron on his chest manifested itself, and wisps of undetectable light on the haystack penetrated into the small cauldron like floating dust.
The green haystacks gradually lost their original color and turned into withered yellow weeds.
In the early morning, Wang Fu was awakened by the dazzling sunlight.
